prop.description: Use when a task spans two or more office formats and needs one workflow across them: covers office, cross-format, multi-format; excludes theme, brand
triggers: convert the Word report to a PDF
put the Excel chart into the slides
draw a poster for the launch should go to canvas-design
prop.why: Dropped the format names (Word/PDF/Excel/slides) and generic words (document/file) that made the coarse checker land on this grouping node for single-format tasks belonging to its children (docx/pdf/xlsx/pptx), and removed the mis-scoped 'status report' group whose canonical word isn't ours.

prop.description: Use when creating, reading or editing Word documents: covers word doc, docx, tracked changes; excludes pdf, slides, spreadsheets
triggers: write our q3 people ops update and hand it to me as a word doc
edit the tracked changes in this docx
merge these two PDF files should go to office-docs/pdf
synonyms: word doc, word, word 文档, word文档, word 报告
prop.why: Dropped 'memo' (pulled internal-comms memos in), 'letter' (substring of 'newsletter') and bare 'word' (substring of 'a certain word' in the Sheets request) as cover words; kept word doc/docx/tracked changes and aliased 'word' so Chinese '转成 Word' requests still land on office-docs/docx.

prop.description: Use when a PDF is the input or a print-ready PDF is the deliverable: covers pdf, print-ready, watermark; excludes png, jpg
triggers: 做张招聘海报，最后要导出成能直接送印的PDF
I need a print-ready one-page overview for a conference booth, delivered as a PDF
Design an A2 poster and export it as PNG and PDF should go to canvas-design
synonyms: pdf, PDF文件, pdf文档, 导出pdf, 输出pdf, pdfs
print-ready, print ready, 送印, 可直接送印, 印刷就绪
prop.why: All routing misses are cases where an existing PDF is the input or a print-ready/prepress PDF is the final deliverable, while the false loads were image-only OCR and plain design exports that merely name PDF as one output format; scoping the situation to PDF-in/print-ready-out and excluding png/jpg separates the two.

prop.description: Use when creating, reading or editing PowerPoint slide decks or presentations: covers pptx, deck, presentation, slide, powerpoint
triggers: build a pitch deck for investors
add speaker notes to these slides
fix the formulas in this spreadsheet should go to office-docs/xlsx
synonyms: deck, 幻灯片, 演示文稿, 演示, 路演, ppt, presentation, slide, slides
prop.why: Adds presentation/slide cover words and folds Chinese/PPT terms to deck so pptx matches deck/presentation requests that also mention theme or brand.

prop.description: Use when a spreadsheet file is the deliverable: covers xlsx, csv, spreadsheet, excel; excludes google sheets formulas, python scripts
triggers: 帮我核对模型计费口径，把 API 成本测算表按最新信息更新一下
clean this csv in my downloads folder, headers in the wrong place, give me back a proper spreadsheet file
用这个 Excel 里的成绩数据做一个网页图表展示 should go to web/frontend-design
synonyms: spreadsheet, 表格, 电子表格, 表
prop.why: Anchor on 'deliverable is a spreadsheet file', exclude google-sheets/python-script asks that caused false loads, and fold Chinese 表格/表 so 表-style requests (成本测算表) hit xlsx.

prop.description: Use when a task spans this group rather than one child skill: covers frontend, tailwind artifact, screenshot; excludes theme, brand, gif
triggers: build a tailwind artifact and test it with playwright
pick the typography, then screenshot the page in the browser
make a GIF for Slack should go to slack-gif-creator
synonyms: frontend, front end, 前端
prop.why: The cover words web/html/react/ui were so generic they substring-matched every request in the false-landing list (even 'ui' inside 'build'), so I narrowed them to distinctive phrases and replaced the stale 'status report/status update' group, which belongs to internal-comms.

prop.description: Use when building or reshaping a UI and choosing its visual direction: covers landing page, dashboard, visual style, distinct, templated; excludes poster
triggers: our landing page looks like every other saas template, help me make it actually feel distinct
build me a kanban board with drag and drop and filter by tag, I will use it for my assignments
design a square insta graphic for the new podcast ep should go to canvas-design
synonyms: visual style, 视觉风格, 视觉方向, look and feel, 好看, 有个性, 别太普通, 辨识度
dashboard, 看板, 数据看板, 仪表盘
prop.why: Bare cover word 'design' caused every false load (cold email, insta graphic, mcp-builder, skill-creator), so it is replaced by request-domain phrases (landing page, dashboard, visual style, distinct, templated) plus Chinese aliases, which recover the UI-build misses while keeping the poster exclusion.

prop.description: Use when building a complex multi-page React artifact with state and routing: covers shadcn, tailwind, routing, state management; excludes aesthetic
triggers: build an artifact with tailwind and shadcn components
make a multi-page artifact with routing and state management
pick a distinctive visual style and typography for a landing page should go to web/frontend-design
synonyms: routing, 路由, 路由跳转, 页面跳转, 多页面跳转
state management, 状态管理, 组件状态
prop.why: Drops generic cover words 'artifact'/'component' that pulled in pure design-direction requests, keeps only discriminating phrases (shadcn, tailwind, routing, state management) and adds Chinese aliases so complex-app requests land here while design-only asks route to frontend-design.

prop.description: Use when testing or debugging a local web app in a browser: covers playwright, browser, console, localhost, local web; excludes typography
triggers: test the login flow with playwright
take a screenshot of localhost:3000 and check the console
choose typography and a color palette for a new landing page should go to web/frontend-design
synonyms: browser, 浏览器
console, 控制台
prop.why: Dropped bare 'screenshot' (it lexically stole the PNG-OCR request), added 'console'/'local web' and Chinese aliases so localhost/browser-debugging requests land here instead of web or root.

prop.description: Use when styling an artifact with a color/font theme: covers theme, palette, typeface, visual treatment; excludes brand
triggers: apply the ocean theme to these slides
give this report a new color palette and matching fonts
use Anthropic brand colors should go to brand-guidelines
synonyms: theme, 主题, 配色, 视觉主题, theming, 换一套主题
typeface, fonts, 字体, 字体搭配
prop.why: Dropped generic cover words 'colors/fonts' (they were matching brand/UI requests) in favor of theme/palette/typeface/visual treatment, and added Chinese aliases so 配色/字体/主题 deck requests hit this skill lexically.

prop.description: Use when an artifact must follow brand colors, type or design standards: covers brand color, brand identity, brand style, design standard, visual standard; excludes theme
triggers: make this deck follow the brand style guide
use our brand colors and typography on this landing page artifact
make a custom theme for our brand so i can reuse it on docs and slides should go to theme-factory
synonyms: brand color, 品牌色, 品牌规范, 品牌手册
design standard, 公司规范, 公司标准
prop.why: Replaced the bare, over-matching cover word 'brand' (which pulled in 'brand rollout', 'brand notes', 'custom theme for our brand') with specific phrases, and added Chinese aliases so the many 品牌色/品牌规范/公司规范 misses land lexically.

create a flow field particle animation
draw a poster for the launch should go to canvas-design

flow field, 流场, 流场图, 流场风格, 流场动画, 粒子, 粒子系统, 粒子动画

prop.description: Use when making a static visual piece to print or share as PNG/PDF: covers poster, art print, header image, visual art, graphic; excludes generative code art
triggers: draw a poster for the launch
make a piece of visual art as a png
make generative art with p5.js should go to algorithmic-art

visual art, 视觉图, 主视觉

prop.description: Use when making an animated GIF for Slack: covers gif, emoji, slack

帮我生成一个动图，表现学生点头理解的表情，用在 Slack 上回复消息。

prop.description: Use when co-writing a structured doc with the user through drafts: covers co-author, technical spec, decision doc; excludes editor pitches
triggers: Help me co-author a technical spec for our engineering team, starting with the outline and then filling it in section by section.
帮我一起写一份技术方案，先对一下大纲、读者和边界，再逐节填充。
Draft a 200-word pitch for my editor about the water utility series should go to discernment-nudge
synonyms: co-author, coauthor, 一起写, 帮我一起, 共同撰写, 协作撰写, 逐节, 分阶段, 一版一版
technical spec, 技术方案, 技术规范, 技术设计文档, 规范文档, 交付规范, 白皮书, white paper, specification

prop.description: Use when writing internal company communications like team announcements: covers status report, memo, newsletter, incident report, internal notice; excludes public help-center content
triggers: write the weekly status report for leadership
draft a short memo to the ed board on why we should run the foia story before election day
I'm writing the FAQ section for our new help center and need friendly copy for it should go to doc-coauthoring
synonyms: status report, status update, 周报, 季度更新
internal notice, 通知, 内部通知, 通报
prop.why: Drops the over-broad 'faq' cover word (which pulled in help-center FAQ work), adds memo/internal notice for the two tree-level misses, and folds Chinese 周报/通知/通报 so the lexical checker catches the Chinese status-report, notice and postmortem requests.

prop.description: Use when building a server or connector that exposes an API or service to an AI assistant as tools: covers mcp server, fastmcp, connector, expose
triggers: build an MCP server for our ticket system
expose our internal product catalog to Claude as a small server with a few well-designed tools
stream a response from the Claude API should go to claude-api
synonyms: connector, connect, 连接器, 接入, 包一层, 封装, 封一下, wrap
mcp server, 服务端, mcp 服务, 工具服务
prop.why: Requests that wrap an API as callable tools rarely say 'mcp'; adding connector/expose cover words plus wrap/connect/包一层/封装/服务端 aliases lets those miss-cases match without pulling in unrelated skills.

prop.description: Use when creating, testing or tuning an agent skill or its description: covers skill, reusable, trigger; excludes one-off tooling
triggers: turn my template and my past examples into a reusable skill so the agent writes updates in our style
our existing skill does not trigger reliably, review it, improve the description and set up evals before and after
build an MCP server for our ticket system should go to mcp-builder
synonyms: skill, 能力模块
reusable, 可复用
prop.why: Replaced the too-literal covers ('new skill', 'make a skill', 'benchmark') with the words the misses actually contain ('skill', 'reusable', 'trigger') plus Chinese aliases, and made the scope/excludes explicit so '从零搭起来 a tool' no longer reads as skill authoring.

prop.description: Use when code calls the Claude API or Anthropic SDK, or exposes an internal system to Claude as tools: covers claude api, anthropic sdk, tool use, model id, prompt caching
triggers: stream a response from the Claude API in Python

prop.description: Use when asking how to use, learn or get started with Claude, or wanting training, onboarding or course material for a team: covers get started, onboarding, training, tutorial, learning
triggers: How do I get started with Claude for my organization?
Is there a course or tutorial I can assign to new hires?
Merging two Google Docs and keeping the comments should go to office-docs/docx

learning, 学习, 学习路径, 学习材料, 学习计划, 上手, 入门, 入门指南

prop.description: Use when drafting an email, memo, recommendation or advice the user will act on: covers email, memo, advice, recommendation; excludes troubleshooting, file summarization
triggers: draft a cold email to 15 design partners, short, no fluff
write a gentle rejection email for a candidate we liked but couldn't hire
make me a GIF for Slack should go to slack-gif-creator
synonyms: email, 邮件
prop.why: The old cover words (advice/recommendation/double-check/verify) skewed to review-and-verify requests, while every real miss was a drafted email/memo or act-on-able recommendation; anchoring on 'email' (plus the Chinese 邮件 alias seen in three misses) and keeping review/troubleshooting in excludes fixes those without touching the technical false loads.
